                    lhs=diff(x^2 + sin(x), x, 2),
                    rhs=2 - sin(x), relation='==', edge=False),
    oracle_instance('_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_',
                    lhs=diff(exp(x) + x^3, x, 2),
                    rhs=exp(x) + 6*x, relation='==', edge=False),
